users.description: Real multi-user accounts. Signup hashes the password with bcrypt before storing it.

boards.description: Multiple boards per user (docs/EXPANSION_PLAN.md iteration 2). user_id is no longer UNIQUE — a user can own any number of boards, each with its own name and set of columns/cards.

columns.description: The Kanban board's fixed columns. id is a stable, randomly-generated string per board (e.g. 'col-a1b2c3d4'), not an autoincrement integer, so it round-trips directly with the frontend's BoardData shape. Generated per board rather than reusing fixed literals like 'col-backlog', since every user now gets their own board and column ids are a shared primary key across all boards.

cards.description: A card belongs to exactly one column. position replaces the frontend's Column.cardIds array — ordering within a column is 'ORDER BY position' instead of an id list.

seed_on_first_boot.description: Only the demo account is seeded at boot. Every new user gets one default board named 'My Board' (db.create_user, which calls db.create_board); users can create additional boards afterward via POST /api/boards.
